title: Hope you get Victoria as your guide
text: Victoria was a knowledgeable and enthusiastic tour guide. With a private tour, she was able to elaborate on aspects of history that were of interest to us. The first part was a walking tour and the second part was a self guided tour of Sagrada Familia. Without her help with the metro, tickets, the audio guide and finding the correct line at a very busy and crowded site, I'm not sure we would have ever made it into the Basilica.
author: mary_c

title: A lovely evening...
text: A lovely evening exploring Barcelona's Gothic Quarter and Old Town. The historic streets, beautiful architecture and atmosphere made it a memorable experience. It was a wonderful opportunity to discover another side of Barcelona, and I would happily recommend this tour to anyone visiting the city.
author: Tarek_K

title: Enjoyed the Old Town walk-a-bout. So much Catalonia history!
text:
My husband and I participated in this small group Tour on Thursday, October 8th, 2026. We loved it! Petra was our wonderful Tour Guide. Her enthusiasm, and breadth of knowledge, made this Tour interesting and enjoyable. We learned a great deal of Catalonian history, which we hoped to achieve on this Tour. We recommend this Tour. 

The suggestion we have for improvement of this Tour: Even though it is a small group Tour, it was difficult to consistently hear Petra due to continuous noise from construction activities, cars, trucks, vans, and motorcycles. Highly recommend provide the Tour Guide,
author: Deborah_I
